limits: No exhaustive crash-free or performance guarantee; soak testing remains necessary.
No physical 16 KB-page device test; all 223 ARM64 ELF images checked statically.
All native tools share a 179 MB engine even for a small selected workload.
Android still requires confirmation when installing or updating the engine; Play Protect checks remain possible.
Hosted C/C++ ASan is unavailable; UBSan and stdlib assertions are not a complete uninitialized-memory detector.
Full IPython/Jupyter, Python language server/debugger, arbitrary executable third-party addons and online marketplace remain unfinished.
Linux/macOS GUI and native installers are not validated by Windows/backend tests.
